summary: eXp World Holdings filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing court approval of a class-action settlement it opted into. The filing updates litigation status only — no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is a routine litigation update, not a special situation.
